subject: Bilingual Sun Park ACTA document room, public-safe OCR text editions and event/source continuity controls

package_state.artifact_kind: public-redacted OCR-assisted text editions, not source facsimiles

publication_boundary: Every package is located-package-partial with complete_public_text and manual_source_line_verification set false.
The PDF and WEBP artifacts are rendered text-edition derivatives, not native ACTA pages, official originals, certified copies or source facsimiles.
The image-only 5 July 2018 source remains located but unpackaged because reliable OCR/manual transcription is pending.
The referenced 10 August 2012 and 20 November 2018 originals remain unlocated in the finite searched universe.
Personal identifiers, signatures, private contact and bank data, owner-level financial rows, tax-reserved material and privileged advice are excluded from the public packages.

evidence: Local package validator passed for 15 manifests, 15 PDFs and 209 WEBP previews: file existence, non-zero decoding, page-count parity, public derivative hashes, PDF render and automated privacy patterns.

Selected public text-edition pages were visually sampled across 2008, 2009, 2011, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2018 and 2022; this cross-year sample does not mark every per-package visual_pdf_sample_review gate complete.
Automated validation does not replace manual line-by-line comparison with each received source page.

open_evidence: manual source-line verification for every represented page and annex
irreversibly redacted source-derived facsimiles and source-page images with hidden-text tests
complete native preservation manifests and independent custody copies
source-family and annex reconciliation, including the 24-page and 77-page 26 April 2016 records
reliable transcription/package for the image-only 5 July 2018 copy
originals for the referenced 10 August 2012 and 20 November 2018 meetings
complete notice, proxy, implementation, challenge and downstream-reliance chain

thread_deletion_audit.reason: Publication of an indexed partial OCR layer does not satisfy native preservation, complete manual transcription, source-facsimile, event-chain or fresh-thread recovery gates.

live_verification.note: DRAFT records local source state only. PR, merge, deployment and public-edge readback must be recorded separately.
